reverse_earned.title: Reverse earned points on cancellations and refunds

negative_balance.title: When points were already spent
negative_balance.description: cap_at_balance: reverse only what is left; allow_negative: the balance may go below zero and later earnings repay it.

partial_refunds.title: Partial refunds
partial_refunds.description: proportional: reverse earned points in proportion to the refunded amount; none: only full refunds reverse.

refund_redeemed.title: Give redeemed points back on cancellations and full refunds
